class Erp:
    """The ERP website: one signed-in context, a tab per worker, so requirements and materials run in parallel."""

    def __init__(self, site: dict, context: BrowserContext, trace: Trace, deadline: float | None = None):
        self.site, self.context, self.trace, self.deadline = site, context, trace, deadline
        self.ready: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.materials: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        self.active_at = 0.0  # last time a worker was using the ERP
        self.busy = 0
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.idle_limit = float(os.environ.get("ERP_IDLE_SECONDS", "200"))
        self.tasks: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        # a few tabs at once: when the ERP drops its session, every open tab signs in again at the same moment
        self.tabs = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("ERP_TABS", "8")))
        self.started_at: float | None = None

    def warm_up(self) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Sign in and get past entry gates once (a model handles gates the helpers cannot), e.g. while the
        specification is still being read."""
        if self.ready is None:
            self.ready = asyncio.create_task(self._warm_up())
        return self.ready

    async def _warm_up(self) -> None:
        session = await self._tab("start")
        await run_worker(session, "Get to the system's main menu or start screen, past any notice or confirmation "
                         "it asks for first, then return.", Ready, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=12,
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        await self._close(session)
        self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    async def _enter(self) -> None:
        """Before a worker starts: a tab slot, and the session signed in and not about to time out. When it sat
        idle for long (the ERP logs out after a few minutes), one tab signs in again before the others pile in."""
        await self.warm_up()
        await self.tabs.acquire()
        async with self.lock:
            if not self.busy and time.monotonic() - self.active_at > self.idle_limit:
                self.ready = None
                await self.warm_up()
            self.busy += 1

    def _leave(self) -> None:
        self.tabs.release()
        self.busy -= 1
        self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    async def _tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession:
        """A new tab in the shared context; `tag` only names it in the trace."""
        session = SiteSession({**self.site, "siteId": f"{self.site['siteId']}:{tag}"}, self.context, self.trace)
        await session.start()
        if url:
            await self.open(session, url)
        return session

    async def open(self, session: SiteSession, url: str) -> bool:
        """Open a link target a model reported, with the same rule as the goto tool: only on this website."""
        target = on_site(self.site, url)
        if target is None:
            self.trace.event(session.name, "link_refused", url=url)
            return False
        async with session.lock:
            await session._goto(target)
        await session.look()
        return True

    @staticmethod
    async def _close(session: SiteSession) -> None:
        for page in session.pages:
            try:
                await page.close()
            except Exception:  # already gone
                continue

    async def requirement(self, req: EffectiveRequirement) -> RequirementResearch:
        out = RequirementResearch(requirement_id=req.requirement_id)
        report = None
        for attempt in range(2):  # retry once: the ERP sometimes drops the session mid-search
            await self._enter()
            try:
                session = await self._tab(req.requirement_id if not attempt else f"{req.requirement_id}+")
                report, _ = await run_worker(session, SEARCH_GOAL.format(group=req.catalog_group, want=_want(req)),
                                             SearchReport, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=14,
                                             **_worker_kwargs(notes=False))
                await self._close(session)
            finally:
                self._leave()
            if report is not None:
                break
        if report is None:
            out.problems.append("search worker returned no result")
            return out
        out.search_term = report.search_term
        out.candidates = [Candidate(material_number=c.material_number.strip(), link=c.link.strip(),
                                    bore=_num(c.bore), stroke=_num(c.stroke), pressure=_num(c.pressure),
                                    mounting=c.mounting, certification=c.certification)
                          for c in report.candidates]
        # every hit of the model's search is inspected (the rules cap a usable search at 20 hits); which one fits is
        # the model's choice below, once the details are known
        out.inspected = list(dict.fromkeys(c.material_number for c in out.candidates))[:MAX_INSPECT]
        if len(out.candidates) > MAX_INSPECT:
            out.problems.append(f"{len(out.candidates)} hits, inspected the first {MAX_INSPECT}")
        links = {c.material_number: c.link for c in out.candidates}
        records = await asyncio.gather(*(self.material(number, links.get(number, "")) for number in out.inspected))
        materials = {r.material_number: r for r in records if r is not None}
        out.selected, problems = await choose_material(req, out, materials, self.trace)
        out.problems += problems
        return out

    def material(self, number: str, link: str = "") -> asyncio.Task:
        """One detail worker per material, shared when several requirements inspect the same one."""
        if number not in self.materials:
            self.materials[number] = asyncio.create_task(self._material(number, link))
        return self.materials[number]

    async def _material(self, number: str, link: str) -> MaterialRecord | None:
        views: dict[str, str] = {}
        record = None
        focus = ""
        for attempt in range(2):  # a second pass, keeping what was read, when facts are missing
            await self._enter()
            try:
                session = await self._tab(number if not attempt else f"{number}+")
                _keep_views(session, views)
                if link:
                    await self.open(session, link)
                coverage, _ = await run_worker(session, DETAIL_GOAL.format(material=number, focus=focus), Coverage,
                                               deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=12, tools=(open_pages,),
                                               **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
                await self._close(session)
            finally:
                self._leave()
            corpus = _corpus(views)
            self.trace.event(session.name, "material_read", views=len(views), chars=len(corpus),
                             not_found=coverage.not_found if coverage else "worker stopped")
            try:
                seen = await _read_material(number, corpus, self.trace, session.name)
            except Exception as error:
                self.trace.event(session.name, "material_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
                continue
            record = _material_record(seen)
            missing = incomplete(record)
            if not missing:
                break
            record.problems.append(f"missing after pass {attempt + 1}: {', '.join(missing)}")
            focus = f"\nStill missing from the views read so far: {', '.join(missing)}. Open the view…5177 tokens truncated…    remembered.update(choices or {})  # a revisit of the position needs the same picks
                error = await fill_position(session, entry, plan, log, remembered)
            except Exception as exc:  # a slow or changed page: the model decides to retry or omit
                error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc).splitlines()[0][:200]}"
            moved = ""
            if not error and self.next_button:  # the model named the button; clicking it is the mechanical part
                view = await session.look()
                ref, why = find_control(view, self.next_button, ("button",))
                target = await locate(session.page, ref) if ref else None
                if target is None:
                    moved = f" Could not save it: {why}; click the form's next/continue button yourself."
                else:
                    await target.click(timeout=5000)
                    await session.settle()
                    moved = f" Saved with {self.next_button!r}; the page below is the form's next step."
            session.trace.event(session.name, "configure_position", position=position, done=log, error=error,
                                moved=moved)
            view = await session.look()
        if error:
            self.failures[position] = self.failures.get(position, 0) + 1
            self.entered.discard(position)
            return (f"Position {position} not fully entered: {error}. Entered so far: {'; '.join(log) or 'nothing'}. "
                    "Fix the mapping and call again, or leave the position out with the form's option to omit "
                    f"it. {self.so_far(session)}\n\n{view}")
        self.entered.add(position)
        then = moved or " Check it, then save and continue with the form's next/continue button."
        return f"Position {position} entered: {'; '.join(log)}.{then} {self.so_far(session)}\n\n{view}"

    def so_far(self, session: SiteSession) -> str:
        """The running net total, told after every position so the totals step needs no arithmetic."""
        total = german(self.total())
        session.seen += "\n" + total  # our own figure: let the worker's result mention it
        entered = ", ".join(sorted(self.entered, key=position_key)) or "none"
        return f"Net total of the positions entered so far: {total} ({entered}); enter the latest such figure."

    def entry_total(self, position: str) -> Decimal:
        entry = self.entries[position]
        return Decimal(str(entry["quantity"])) * Decimal(str(entry["unit_price"]))

    def total(self, omitted: set[str] = frozenset()) -> Decimal:
        return sum((self.entry_total(p) for p in self.entered - omitted), Decimal(0))

    def expected(self) -> str:
        """What the review should show for each position entered, for the summary check and the signing pass."""
        lines = []
        for p in sorted(self.entered, key=position_key):
            e = self.entries[p]
            extra = ", ".join(f"{label} {german(e[key])}" for key, label in (
                ("base_unit_price", "base price"), ("surcharge_per_unit", "surcharge per piece"),
                ("packaging_per_unit", "packaging per piece"), ("rebate_total", "bonus for the position"))
                if e.get(key) is not None)
            lines.append(f"  - position {p}: material {e['material_number']}, quantity {e['quantity']}, net unit "
                         f"price {german(e['unit_price'])}, lead time {e['lead_time_weeks']} weeks"
                         + (f", {extra}" if extra else ""))
        return "\n".join(lines)

    async def net_total(self, omitted: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
        """
        The bid's net total in German format: quantity x unit price summed over the positions entered with
        configure_position(), minus any listed in `omitted` (positions you left out after all).
        """
        dropped = {p.strip() for p in omitted or []}
        return f"{german(self.total(dropped))} (positions {', '.join(sorted(self.entered - dropped)) or 'none'})"


def _positions(answer: dict | None, desk: PositionDesk, filled: bool) -> str:
    """
    The decision and position part of the requirements: before the form phase, how to enter them; after it, what
    the review must show (the positions actually entered, all others omitted, the total of the entered ones).
    """
    discount = german((answer or {}).get("discount_percent") or 0)
    if answer and answer.get("decision") == "no_bid":
        return ("- decision: no bid: choose the form's declaration that you do not submit an offer (not a main or "
                f"alternative offer); no positions;\n- discount {discount} and net total 0,00;")
    head = "- decision: bid (main offer, not an alternative offer);\n"
    if filled and desk.entered:
        return head + (f"- exactly {len(desk.entered)} position(s) entered, each with these values:\n"
                       f"{desk.expected()}\n"
                       "- every other position omitted, and no added or extra position;\n"
                       f"- discount {discount} and net total {german(desk.total())} (German number format; never a "
                       "gross amount);")
    if not desk.entries:
        return head + ("- leave every position out with the form's option to omit a position (where the form shows "
                       "one position per step, omit each in turn); do not configure materials, prices or lead times, "
                       f"and never use options that add positions;\n- discount {discount} and net total 0,00 (German "
                       "number format);")
    names = sorted({key for entry in desk.entries.values() for key in entry} - {"position"})
    return head + f"""- enter exactly these positions: {', '.join(sorted(desk.entries))}. The form shows one position
  at a time, in its own order. On every position page, first call configure_position() with the number the page
  shows: it enters all values of a position of this bid and saves it with the next/continue button you name, or
  tells you to omit it. Never pick options or type position values yourself;
- configure_position() needs, once, which control takes which value: map each control's label (as your view shows
  it) to one of these value names: {', '.join(names)}. Choices that open further choices (attributes of the
  material) map to the attribute with the same meaning; the material/catalogue number control to material_number;
  unit price, base price, surcharge, packaging and the bonus or rebate for the whole position to unit_price,
  base_unit_price, surcharge_per_unit, packaging_per_unit and rebate_total; lead time to lead_time_weeks. Leave out
  controls with no matching value. Also name the button that applies a choice so the next one opens, and the
  button that saves the position and goes on to the next step (not the ones that omit or add a position);
- leave out, with the form's option to omit a position, every other position and any position where
  configure_position() reports a problem it cannot resolve. Never use options that add positions; if the form
  shows an extra position you did not ask for, remove it or leave it out;
- discount {discount}; net total: the latest figure configure_position() reports for the positions entered so
  far (net_total() repeats it; pass positions you entered but left out after all). Enter both exactly as given
  (German number format), never a sum you work out yourself, a gross amount or a sum the page proposes;"""

async def check_summary(view: str, requirements: str) -> SummaryCheck | None:
    """One model call (thinking off by default, THINKING_REVIEW) on the review page before signing."""
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=SummaryCheck, retries=2,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(llm.thinking("review", False)),
                  instructions="You check the final review page of a bid against the bidder's requirements before "
                               "it is signed. Report only what the page visibly contradicts (a wrong or missing "
                               "value, a position that is not omitted, an extra position, a wrong offer type); "
                               "requirements the page does not show at all are no problem.")
    try:
        result = await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(f"Requirements:\n{requirements}\n\nReview page:\n{view}"), 90)
    except Exception:  # a failed check means the signing worker checks the page itself, with thinking on
        return None
    return result.output

def effective_requirement(req: Requirement, amendments: list[calc.Amendment] | None = None,
                          reserves: dict[str, Decimal] | None = None,
                          scenario_date: date | None = None) -> EffectiveRequirement:
    """

    by the caller; revision and requirement scoping and latest-wins happen here) and the per-end reserve values of
    the revision-specific Technikfreigabe, by reserve key. Without a needed reserve the stroke stays open.

    base: dict[str, Decimal | str] = {"bore": req.bore, "stroke": req.stroke, "pressure": req.pressure,
                                      "mounting": req.mounting, "certification": req.certification}
    attrs = calc.apply_amendments(base, amendments or [], req.revision, req.requirement_id, scenario_date)
    pending: list[str] = []

class Mailbox:
    """The bidder's webmail, worked by the model on request; one request at a time in its tab."""

    def __init__(self, session: SiteSession, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float):
        self.session, self.briefing, self.deadline = session, briefing, deadline
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.last_tan = ""

    async def address(self) -> str:
        async with self.lock:
            found, _ = await run_worker(
                self.session, "Find the email address of the mailbox you are signed in to (the bidder's own "
                "address, usually shown as the signed-in account). Return it at once.",
                MailboxAddress, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=8, notes=False)
        return found.address if found else ""

    async def tan(self, answer: str = "") -> SigningTan | None:
        """
        The signing TAN just requested. The sites run on the scenario's clock, so "newest" is the highest request
        number or the top of the list, never a wall-clock time. `answer` is what the bid website said to the request
        (it may name the request), so the mail worker can pick that very message.
        """
        older = f" The TAN {self.last_tan} you returned before is no longer valid." if self.last_tan else ""
        said = (f" The bid website answered the request with: {answer!r}; pick the message for that request."
                if answer else "")
        async with self.lock:
            async with self.session.lock:  # the list the tab shows predates the request: load it again
                await self.session._goto(self.session.page.url)
            found, _ = await run_worker(
                self.session, f"A new signing TAN for tender {self.briefing.tender_reference} was just requested."
                f"{said} Open the newest signing TAN message for exactly this tender reference (the highest "
                "request number; new TAN messages are listed without a search, newest first; reload the list once "
                "if it is not there yet), copy the TAN from its text and return it at once. If a preview pane "
                f"stays empty, open the message's own page through its link.{older}",
                SigningTan, context=answer, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=10, notes=False)
        if found:
            self.last_tan = found.tan
        return found

async def run_worker(session: SiteSession, goal: str, output_type: type[T], *, context: str = "",
                     deadline: float | None = None, max_steps: int = 40, thinking: bool = False,
                     grounded: bool = True, tools: tuple = (), notes: bool = True
                     ) -> tuple[T | None, dict[str, str]]:
    """Work `goal` on the session's website until the model returns `output_type`; None when out of time or steps.

    `deadline` is a `time.monotonic()` value. With `grounded`, a result whose values (anything with a digit) appear
    on no page the worker saw goes back to the model. `tools` adds tools beyond the browser ones; `notes=False`
    drops note() for short lookups that should just return. The notes the model recorded are returned either way.
    """
    deps = Deps(session=session)
    browser = [tool for tool in TOOLS if notes or tool.__name__ != "note"]
    instructions = INSTRUCTIONS if notes else INSTRUCTIONS.replace(
        "Record every fact you establish with note() as soon as you have it, then return the result.",
        "Return the result as soon as you have it.")
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=output_type, deps_type=Deps, instructions=instructions,
                  tools=[*browser, *tools, *clef.tools()], model_settings=llm.settings(thinking), retries=4,
                  capabilities=[ProcessHistory(_forget_old_views)])
    if grounded:
        @agent.output_validator
        def _seen(ctx: RunContext[Deps], output):
            text = output.model_dump_json() if hasattr(output, "model_dump_json") else str(output)
            missing = unseen_values(text, ctx.deps.session.seen + "\n" + context)
            if missing:
                session.trace.event(session.name, "output_refused", missing=missing[:10])
                raise ModelRetry(f"{', '.join(missing[:10])} appear on no page you have seen. Return only values "
                                 f"copied from pages; open them again to check.")
            return output

    view = await session.look(fresh=True)
    prompt = f"Website: {session.name} ({session.site['url']})\n\nGoal: {goal}\n"
    if context:
        prompt += f"\nContext:\n{context}\n"
    prompt += f"\n{CURRENT_VIEW}{view}"
    started = time.monotonic()
    timeout = None if deadline is None else max(1.0, deadline - started)
    session.trace.event(session.name, "start", goal=goal)
    output = None
    usage = RunUsage()  # filled as the run goes, so a stopped run still reports what it used
    try:
        result = await asyncio.wait_for(
            agent.run(prompt, deps=deps, usage=usage, usage_limits=UsageLimits(request_limit=max_steps)), timeout)
        output = result.output
        session.trace.event(session.name, "done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                            requests=usage.requests, input_tokens=usage.input_tokens,
                            cached_tokens=usage.cache_read_tokens, output_tokens=usage.output_tokens,
                            output=repr(output)[:500])
    except (asyncio.TimeoutError, UsageLimitExceeded, UnexpectedModelBehavior) as error:
        session.trace.event(session.name, "stopped", reason=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}",
                            seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), requests=usage.requests,
                            input_tokens=usage.input_tokens, cached_tokens=usage.cache_read_tokens,
                            output_tokens=usage.output_tokens)
    return output, deps.notes

    def __init__(self, session: SiteSession, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float):
        self.session, self.briefing, self.deadline = session, briefing, deadline
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.last_tan = ""

    async def address(self) -> str:
        async with self.lock:
            found, _ = await run_worker(
                self.session, "Find the email address of the mailbox you are signed in to (the bidder's own "
                "address, usually shown as the signed-in account). Return it at once.",
                MailboxAddress, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=8, notes=False)
        return found.address if found else ""

    async def tan(self, answer: str = "") -> SigningTan | None:
        """
        The signing TAN just requested. The sites run on the scenario's clock, so "newest" is the highest request
        number or the top of the list, never a wall-clock time. `answer` is what the bid website said to the request
        (it may name the request), so the mail worker can pick that very message.
        """
        older = f" The TAN {self.last_tan} you returned before is no longer valid." if self.last_tan else ""
        said = (f" The bid website answered the request with: {answer!r}; pick the message for that request."
                if answer else "")
        async with self.lock:
            async with self.session.lock:  # the list the tab shows predates the request: load it again
                await self.session._goto(self.session.page.url)
            found, _ = await run_worker(
                self.session, f"A new signing TAN for tender {self.briefing.tender_reference} was just requested."
                f"{said} Open the newest signing TAN message for exactly this tender reference (the highest "
                "request number; new TAN messages are listed without a search, newest first; reload the list once "
                "if it is not there yet), copy the TAN from its text and return it at once. If a preview pane "
                f"stays empty, open the message's own page through its link.{older}",
                SigningTan, context=answer, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=10, notes=False)

async def research_mail(sessions: list[SiteSession], reference: str, scenario: datetime, brief: str, *,
                        findings: str = "", kinds: list[Kind] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None
                        ) -> MailFacts:
    """The record kinds a model plans from the brief (or `kinds`, planned earlier with `plan_searches`), searched
    in parallel over the given webmail tabs (one kind per tab at a time)."""
    address = asyncio.create_task(mailbox_address(sessions[0]))
    if kinds is None:
        kinds = await plan_searches(brief, {sessions[0].name: sessions[0].site["url"]}, findings)
    elsewhere = [k for k in kinds if k.site != sessions[0].name]  # the plan put these on another website
    kinds = [k for k in kinds if k.site == sessions[0].name]
    sessions[0].trace.event(sessions[0].name, "mail_plan", kinds=[f"{k.name}: {k.subject} / {k.sender}" for k in kinds],
                            elsewhere=[f"{k.name} on {k.site}" for k in elsewhere])
    queue: asyncio.Queue[Kind] = asyncio.Queue()
    for kind in kinds:
        queue.put_nowait(kind)
    results: list[KindResult] = []

    async def tab(session: SiteSession) -> None:
        while not queue.empty():
            kind = queue.get_nowait()
            try:
                results.append(await research_kind(session, kind, reference, deadline=deadline))
            except Exception as error:  # one failed kind must not cost the others
                session.trace.event(session.name, "mail_kind_failed", record_kind=kind.name,
                                    error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")

    await asyncio.gather(*(tab(s) for s in sessions))
    mailbox = await address
    domain = mailbox.split("@", 1)[1] if "@" in mailbox else ""
    facts = resolve_mail(results, reference, domain, scenario, mailbox)
    facts.problems += [f"{k.name}: planned on website {k.site}, not researched here" for k in elsewhere]
    return facts

def bid_clauses(tender: TenderFacts, mail: MailFacts) -> BidClauses:
    problems: list[str] = []
    positions = []
    for p in tender.positions:
        own: list[str] = []
        scope = DiscountScope.BASE_ONLY
        if p.condition_group:
            if p.condition_group in mail.discount_scopes:
                scope = mail.discount_scopes[p.condition_group]
            else:
                own.append(f"condition group {p.condition_group} not in the Konditionsregeln")
        packaging = mail.packaging.get(p.packaging_key) if p.packaging_key else None
        if p.packaging_key and packaging is None:
            own.append(f"packaging tariff {p.packaging_key} not found")
        commitment = mail.commitments.get(p.commitment_key) if p.commitment_key else None
        if p.commitment_key and commitment is None:
            own.append(f"commitment {p.commitment_key} not found")
        positions.append(PositionClauses(position=p.position, quantity=p.quantity, unit=p.unit.value,
                                         discount_scope=scope, setup_fee=p.setup_fee, packaging=packaging,
                                         commitment=commitment, problems=own))

    def one(keys: set[str], table: dict, what: str):
        if len(keys) > 1:
            problems.append(f"several {what} keys {sorted(keys)}; calc takes one")
        key = next(iter(sorted(keys)), None)
        if key is not None and key not in table:
            problems.append(f"{what} {key} not found in the mails")
        return key, table.get(key) if key else None

    pool_key, pool = one({p.setup_pool_key for p in tender.positions if p.setup_pool_key}, mail.setup_pools,
                         "setup pool")
    setup_pool = None
    if pool is not None:
        setup_pool = SetupPool(fee=pool.fee, allocation=pool.allocation, tie_order=pool.tie_order,
                               rest_base=pool.rest_base,
                               members=[p.position for p in tender.positions if p.setup_pool_key == pool_key])
    bonus_key, bonus = one({p.bonus_key for p in tender.positions if p.bonus_key}, mail.project_bonuses,
                           "project bonus")
    project_bonus = None
    if bonus is not None:
        project_bonus = ProjectBonus(bands=bonus.bands, include_surcharge=bonus.include_surcharge,
                                     members=[p.position for p in tender.positions if p.bonus_key == bonus_key])
    return BidClauses(approval=mail.approval, fx_rates=mail.fx_rates, metal_indices=mail.metal_indices,
                      setup_pool=setup_pool, project_bonus=project_bonus, positions=positions, problems=problems)

async def read_qa(pages: list[str], reference: str) -> QaRecords:
    """Each page view read on its own, in parallel (short answers, fast), then merged without duplicates."""
    parts = await asyncio.gather(*(_read(QaRecords, QA_INSTRUCTIONS, page, f"Tender {reference}. Bidder Q&A page:")
                                   for page in pages))
    merged = QaRecords(number_format=next((p.number_format for p in parts if p.number_format), ""))
    for name in QaRecords.model_fields:
        if name == "number_format":
            continue
        seen: dict[str, BaseModel] = {}
        for part in parts:
            for record in getattr(part, name):
                seen.setdefault(record.model_dump_json(), record)
        setattr(merged, name, list(seen.values()))
    return merged


async def research_tender(session: SiteSession, reference: str, scenario: datetime, *,
                          deadline: float | None = None) -> TenderFacts | None:
    """Positions and Q&A of the tender, resolved per position. None when no positions were found."""
    started = time.monotonic()
    collected = Collected()
    documents: list[str] = []
    _, notes = await run_worker(session, _goal(reference), Summary, deadline=deadline, max_steps=20,
                                thinking=False, grounded=False,
                                tools=(paging_tool(collected), keep_tool(documents)))
    if not documents:  # the worker read the documents in its own tab instead
        documents = [session.seen]
    qa_pages = collected.pages or [session.seen]  # without collect_pages: the answers it saw itself
    positions, qa = await asyncio.gather(read_positions("\n\n".join(documents), reference),
                                         read_qa(qa_pages, reference))
    if not positions.positions:
        session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_failed", notes=notes)
        return None
    facts = resolve_tender(positions.positions, qa, scenario, positions.number_format or None)
    facts.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
    session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_facts", seconds=facts.seconds,
                        positions=[p.model_dump(mode="json") for p in facts.positions])
    return facts

def _same_ref(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
    return a.strip().casefold() == b.strip().casefold()


def _latest_key(records: list[QaKey], position: str, withdrawn: set[str], scenario: datetime) -> str | None:
    live = [r for r in records if _same_ref(r.position, position) and r.answer_number not in withdrawn
            and _aware(r.date) <= scenario]
    return max(live, key=lambda r: (_aware(r.date), position_key(r.answer_number))).key if live else None


def _aware(value: datetime) -> datetime:
    return value if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)


def _decimal_or_text(value: str, fmt: str | None) -> Decimal | str:
    try:
        return parse_number(value, fmt) if re.fullmatch(r"\s*[-+]?\d[\d.,'\s]*", value) else value.strip()
    except ParseError:
        return value.strip()


def resolve_tender(positions: list[TenderPosition], qa: QaRecords, scenario: datetime,
                   positions_format: str | None = None) -> TenderFacts:
    """Rules 1, 13, 14 and the Q&A keys: latest dated answer per position and key, withdrawn ones ignored."""
    scenario = _aware(scenario)
    withdrawn = {w.withdrawn_number for w in qa.withdrawals if _aware(w.date) <= scenario}
    fmt = qa.number_format or None
    changes = [QuantityChange(number=c.answer_number, date=_aware(c.date), position=c.position,
                              quantity=parse_int(c.quantity, fmt))
               for c in qa.quantity_changes if _aware(c.date) <= scenario]
    facts = []
    for p in sorted(positions, key=lambda p: position_key(p.position)):
        mine = [c for c in changes if _same_ref(c.position, p.position)]
        for c in mine:
            c.position = p.position
        original = parse_int(p.quantity, positions_format)
        final = resolve_quantity(original, p.position, mine, withdrawn, scenario)
        live = [c for c in mine if c.number not in withdrawn]
        source = max(live, key=lambda c: (c.date, position_key(c.number))).number if live else None
        fees = [f for f in qa.setup_fees if _same_ref(f.position, p.position) and f.answer_number not in withdrawn
                and _aware(f.date) <= scenario]
        fee = parse_number(max(fees, key=lambda f: _aware(f.date)).amount, fmt) if fees else Decimal(0)
        facts.append(PositionFacts(
            position=p.position, short_text=p.short_text, requirement=p.requirement, unit=parse_unit(p.unit),
            unit_text=p.unit, tender_quantity=original, quantity=final, quantity_answer=source,
            condition_group=_latest_key(qa.condition_groups, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
            packaging_key=_latest_key(qa.packaging_tariffs, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
            commitment_key=_latest_key(qa.delivery_commitments, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
            setup_pool_key=_latest_key(qa.setup_pools, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
            bonus_key=_latest_key(qa.project_bonuses, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
            setup_fee=fee))
    amendments = [Amendment(date=_aware(a.date), revision=a.revision, requirement=a.requirement,
                            attributes={a.attribute if a.attribute != "other" else a.attribute_label:
                                        _decimal_or_text(a.value, fmt)})
                  for a in qa.amendments if a.answer_number not in withdrawn and _aware(a.date) <= scenario]
    units = {a.attribute: a.unit for a in qa.amendments if a.unit}
    return TenderFacts(positions=facts, amendments=amendments, amendment_units=units, withdrawn=sorted(withdrawn),
                       qa=qa)

    fmt = qa.number_format or None

async def research_mail(sessions: list[SiteSession], reference: str, scenario: datetime, brief: str, *,
                        findings: str = "", kinds: list[Kind] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None
                        ) -> MailFacts:
    """The record kinds a model plans from the brief (or `kinds`, planned earlier with `plan_searches`), searched
    in parallel over the given webmail tabs (one kind per tab at a time)."""

    if kinds is None:
        kinds = await plan_searches(brief, {sessions[0].name: sessions[0].site["url"]}, findings)
    elsewhere = [k for k in kinds if k.site != sessions[0].name]  # the plan put these on another website

    sessions[0].trace.event(sessions[0].name, "mail_plan", kinds=[f"{k.name}: {k.subject} / {k.sender}" for k in kinds],
                            elsewhere=[f"{k.name} on {k.site}" for k in elsewhere])
    queue: asyncio.Queue[Kind] = asyncio.Queue()
    for kind in kinds:
        queue.put_nowait(kind)

        while not queue.empty():
            kind = queue.get_nowait()

def bid_clauses(tender: TenderFacts, mail: MailFacts) -> BidClauses:
    problems: list[str] = []
    positions = []
    for p in tender.positions:
        own: list[str] = []
        scope = DiscountScope.BASE_ONLY
        if p.condition_group:
            if p.condition_group in mail.discount_scopes:
                scope = mail.discount_scopes[p.condition_group]
            else:
                own.append(f"condition group {p.condition_group} not in the Konditionsregeln")
        packaging = mail.packaging.get(p.packaging_key) if p.packaging_key else None
        if p.packaging_key and packaging is None:
            own.append(f"packaging tariff {p.packaging_key} not found")
        commitment = mail.commitments.get(p.commitment_key) if p.commitment_key else None
        if p.commitment_key and commitment is None:
            own.append(f"commitment {p.commitment_key} not found")
        positions.append(PositionClauses(position=p.position, quantity=p.quantity, unit=p.unit.value,
                                         discount_scope=scope, setup_fee=p.setup_fee, packaging=packaging,
                                         commitment=commitment, problems=own))

    def one(keys: set[str], table: dict, what: str):
        if len(keys) > 1:
            problems.append(f"several {what} keys {sorted(keys)}; calc takes one")
        key = next(iter(sorted(keys)), None)
        if key is not None and key not in table:
            problems.append(f"{what} {key} not found in the mails")
        return key, table.get(key) if key else None

    pool_key, pool = one({p.setup_pool_key for p in tender.positions if p.setup_pool_key}, mail.setup_pools,
                         "setup pool")
    setup_pool = None
    if pool is not None:
        setup_pool = SetupPool(fee=pool.fee, allocation=pool.allocation, tie_order=pool.tie_order,
                               rest_base=pool.rest_base,
                               members=[p.position for p in tender.positions if p.setup_pool_key == pool_key])
    bonus_key, bonus = one({p.bonus_key for p in tender.positions if p.bonus_key}, mail.project_bonuses,
                           "project bonus")
    project_bonus = None
    if bonus is not None:
        project_bonus = ProjectBonus(bands=bonus.bands, include_surcharge=bonus.include_surcharge,
                                     members=[p.position for p in tender.positions if p.bonus_key == bonus_key])
    return BidClauses(approval=mail.approval, fx_rates=mail.fx_rates, metal_indices=mail.metal_indices,
                      setup_pool=setup_pool, project_bonus=project_bonus, positions=positions, problems=problems)
